title: signallog.price.tick.v1
description: One price tick in a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope, JSON structured mode (ADR 0012). Unknown attributes and data fields are allowed: additive changes keep the version, consumers ignore what they do not know.

id.description: UUID version 7, canonical lowercase string (ADR 0012); the Service Bus MessageId and the Cosmos DB id.

source.description: The adapter that produced the event.

time.description: When the adapter produced the event, UTC; equal to the timestamp in the id.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context, CloudEvents distributed tracing extension (ADR 0007).

utcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a trailing Z (ADR 0017).

instrumentId.description: {venueMic}.{productCode}.{deliveryPeriodId} (ADR 0014); never a relative tenor or a continuous series.

price.description: Price in currency per unit; a decimal in .NET, never a double (ADR 0012).

eventTimeUtc.description: The venue's timestamp of the price, UTC (ADR 0017).

sourceKind.description: LIVE from a licensed source, REPLAY from the generator (BR-PRICE-03).
